plan: A lich who keeps casting spells after death and damages the whole enemy team with his ultimate.
aSurveiller: His R (Requiem). It damages every enemy champion, wherever they are: when you are low on health, go back to base.
contrer: When low on health, recall: his R hits anywhere on the map.
After killing him, back off: he keeps casting his spells for a few seconds.
Interrupt his R with crowd control: he has to channel it for 3 seconds.
forces: His R hits the whole enemy team.

sorts.P: After death he can still cast spells.
sorts.Q: Delayed explosion, stronger on a single target.
sorts.W: Wall that slows and reduces magic resist.
sorts.R: Damages every enemy champion after 3 seconds.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 6, very strong in the mid game.
